domain: Evidence, calculations, epistemic aggregation and readiness algorithms

findings.title: Auditor disagreement manufactures demonstrated failures using the synthesis citations
findings.trigger: Synthesis passes each option with positive evidence; the auditor says fail with an empty basis_refs list (valid provider output).
findings.impact: Both options become fail, retain the synthesis positive citation and synthesizer attribution, and the report publishes no_feasible_option as though each failure had been demonstrated.
findings.validation: probes.py:audit_disagreement; probe-results.json:audit_disagreement; actual validate_output and build_report passed.
findings.fix: Represent disputed as unknown until a scoped adverse assessment has a valid supporting basis. Preserve both verdicts, respective citations and assessor identities; use the actual supported failing assessment when deriving infeasibility.
findings.caveat: Report reason does mention disagreement, but the authoritative failure/readiness labels still assert demonstrated failure. No live model behavior is needed for reproduction.

findings.title: First query exhausts page allowance and starves cost/counterevidence retrieval
findings.trigger: Ordinary first comparison query returns eight valid unique hits.
findings.impact: All eight fetch slots go to first-query results. Later cost and counterevidence searches still consume authorizations but none of their pages can be fetched; summary lists all three queries and no limitations.
findings.validation: probes.py:counterevidence_starvation runs real execute_research with synthetic SQLite ledger and stub search/page transports; all saved URLs are query1, later_query_sources_fetched=0, limitations=[].
findings.fix: Reserve page slots per objective or interleave candidate collection and acquisition; stop searches that cannot yield inspectable evidence or record discovery-only results explicitly; disclose unsatisfied research objectives.
findings.caveat: Plan rotation is locally correct; execution allocation is the failure. Duplicate hits or early failed fetches can change outcomes, but eight fresh hits are sufficient.

findings.title: A contradicted claim chain can be promoted to supported without new evidence
findings.trigger: New fact repeats the exact proposition of a prior contradicted fact and cites only that fact; prior fact references a contradicted source saying the opposite.
findings.impact: Graph reachability marks the new claim grounded and validate_output leaves evidence_status=supported. Persisted-claim checks use the same status-insensitive source roots and graph, so circulation among agents can erase known contradiction.
findings.validation: probes.py:support_laundering calls validate_output with identical prior/current proposition and explicit contradictory source; returns supported. Persistence path verified by source review.
findings.fix: Preserve signed support/contradiction edges and evidence qualifications. Block status upgrades based solely on contradicted/mixed/stale ancestors; require a new explicit scoped support assessment and resolution record.
findings.caveat: This is a reproducible polarity/status loss, not a claim that a graph algorithm can prove semantic entailment. Opposite propositions can legitimately cite a refutation, so relation identity and polarity must be explicit.

findings.title: Bounded dissent aggregation can discard the final auditor and ignores proposal critical defects
findings.trigger: Two earlier proposals provide twelve distinct dissent strings each; final auditor contributes material dissent/critical text. Separately, a proposal puts a concern in critical_defects and later stages omit it.
findings.impact: Only first20 dissent strings publish, omitting all final auditor specifics. Proposal critical_defects never enter aggregate and do not set unresolved_critical_defect unless the last audit repeats them.
findings.validation: probes.py:dissent_loss returns dissent_count=20 and no AUDITOR marker; separate proposal-critical probe produces empty dissent and false unresolved flag.
findings.fix: Maintain objection IDs, targets, materiality, dispositions and response links across stages; reserve display capacity for unresolved audit defects and attach overflow links/counts rather than silently dropping records.
findings.caveat: Saved contributions preserve the original text and the final-audit generic unresolved flag survives. Claim is loss from report aggregation/required resolution, not deletion from storage.

findings.title: Ordinary live inputs have no path to accepted evidence support and ready_to_choose
findings.trigger: A live run has complete correct user-entered costs, all requirements passed and distinct successful audit.
findings.impact: Every cost source is rewritten to a synthetic user_supplied evidence record; ready dependency requires verification_status=supported. No application service promotes evidence into supported, so ordinary runs remain conditional regardless of review quality.
findings.validation: probes.py:missing_verification_transition yields conditional with user_supplied; direct synthetic supported status yields ready. Static scan of all source writes found no supported transition.
findings.fix: Implement explicit source-to-cost verification and immutable scoped assessment records (possibly human-attested); preserve unverified distinction. Do not fix by automatically trusting model consensus or all entered costs.
findings.caveat: Conservative state is safer than overclaiming and may be intentional pending a verification feature; report as missing acceptance capability, not false positive readiness.

findings.title: Evidence extraction always chooses page prefix rather than relevant or contradictory passages
findings.trigger: A relevant cost exclusion appears after extracted character4000 of a fetched page.
findings.impact: The only two selected passages end at4000, so no agent sees the later exclusion even though the entire page was downloaded. Long navigation and introductions consume capacity.
findings.validation: probes.py:prefix_passages source is4249 characters with critical exclusion after4200; selected4000 omits it.
findings.fix: Use bounded query/requirement-aware passage retrieval and diversity, preserve exact locators/hashes, explicitly search for exception/exclusion passages, and expose uninspected coverage. Evaluate recall with adversarial long-document fixtures before trusting ranking.
findings.caveat: Current scope labels correctly state that semantic support is unchecked and design docs admit excerpt limits. This is an accuracy capability gap, not misrepresented full-document verification.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Claim support graph and cycle detection
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Every supported fact must have a noncircular scoped support path; a contradicted predecessor must not alone justify supported status.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(V+E); at most 220 current/prior claims.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Local claim aliases, reference validation and persistent ID rewrite
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Unique local aliases map atomically to new persistent IDs; every reference must be local or scoped.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(total response structure + references); 20 claims/40 unique refs.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Immutable claim versions and packet validation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Stored owner/run/hash/version must match and validated support status must remain sound.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Bounded 200 claims and their edges.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Explicit parent selection and freshness downgrade
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Import only approved immutable parent content in the same meeting; time-sensitive/unselected support cannot remain accepted.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(selected records + selected references); 24 selections.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Public query scope, fingerprint and template rendering
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Private brief/location must never become a fallback query; only approved term and template identities may be rendered.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: At most eight 120-character terms, bounded region/templates.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Greedy query packing and rotated template plan
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Every approved term group remains represented within six queries; comparison/cost/counterevidence templates rotate.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(terms * templates * rendered text), all bounded. Execution defeats diversity: E-F02.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Search authorization, frozen plan, lease fencing and uncertain settlement
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Never repeat an ambiguous authorized search; only current run/fence/lease may commit evidence.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: At most six searches; bounded deadline.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Public-search candidate/page allocation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Acquisition should reserve room for cost/counterevidence objectives and disclose unfulfilled objectives.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Greedy first-query-first, max eight pages.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Search transport response parsing and URL filtering
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Bound query/response/credentials; search results are candidates, never verified evidence.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: At most eight hits, 262144 response bytes.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Public DNS admission and target/secret validation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: All resolved addresses must be public; reject credential-bearing URLs, pin IP, bound outstanding DNS work.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: At most two resolver workers; 16 decode rounds.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Deadline-enforced HTTPS fetch and redirects
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Total wall deadline/byte cap applies across network reads and redirects; TLS SNI retains origin host.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: One MiB/page, max four redirect targets, eight page attempts.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: HTML text extraction and source fingerprinting
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Extract canonical text and preserve source origin/hash without calling it semantically verified.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Linear in capped page bytes; no relevance model.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Passage selection, origin grouping and bounded packet
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Selected evidence must cover decisive relevant terms and disclose omitted parts.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Prefix-only 2*2000 characters/source in live service.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Typed decimal expression evaluation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Units, operation depth, operand count, magnitude, precision and rounding must remain explicit.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: 120 leaves, four operation levels; O(expression nodes).

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Lifecycle cost, discounts, unknowns and expiry
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Unknown/excluded/expired cost cannot become complete total; mixed currencies cannot be silently summed.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: 30 cost components/option; exact Decimal64 then minor-unit rounding.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Break-even linear cost solution
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Complete supplied component rates must be current; equal slopes/negative crossing rejected; no forecast or proof all real charges supplied.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(components), two affine cost curves; not called by live report comparison.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Pinned currency minor-unit lookup
algorithm_inventory.assessment: static implementation reviewed; source currency table not externally revalidated
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Unknown currencies must fail rather than default to two places.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(1) lookup; pinned data requires separately controlled updates.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Comparison date and deterministic cost constraints
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Use run-created date in brief timezone; verify all cost categories; deterministic cost constraints override model claims.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(options * (components + hard requirements)).

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Synthesis/audit constraint reconciliation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Changing a verdict must carry its actual evidence and assessor; disagreement alone is not demonstrated failure.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(options * requirements); scoped evidence membership.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Cost dependency support and evidence promotion
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Readiness requires accepted current support, with a real transition that can establish that support.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Source status conjunction over included cost components.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Readiness decision reducer
algorithm_inventory.invariant: No-feasible requires demonstrated failures; ready requires distinct successful audit, two proposals, all requirements and supported dependencies.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Linear in compared constraints/dependencies; upstream false basis accepted.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Dissent and critical-defect aggregation
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Material unresolved objections must remain visible through bounded report generation.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Ordered deduplication then first20 truncation.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Next-evidence requests and parent change summary
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Missing cost/requirement results generate inspectable next actions; linked changes reflect saved inputs.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: First20 items; no information-gain ranking, dependency sensitivity or full material-objection mapping.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Outcome-inclusive timing measurement
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Timing must derive from committed samples, retain unsuccessful outcomes and distinguish queue/input wait/active clocks.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: O(events log events) sorting plus linear scan; not a human usefulness validation.

algorithm_inventory.algorithm: Saved evidence/calculation/report contract gates
algorithm_inventory.assessment: no new local integrity defect found
algorithm_inventory.invariant: Mode, lineage, exact calculation totals/currency/horizon, reference scope and reducer-derived readiness must agree.
algorithm_inventory.complexity_or_bounds: Bounded comparisons/references; semantic truth remains outside schema.

validation.initial_invalid_test_command: One initial pytest invocation named nonexistent test_evidence.py; it collected no tests (exit4). Corrected command passed328.

limitations: No paid providers or real external retrieval were invoked.
Synthetic transport and report probes establish deterministic control/data-flow defects, not frequency in natural model outputs.
Currency table upstream publication and actual monetary/cost market inputs were not externally validated.
The report readiness and claim validations cannot establish real-world correctness without scoped semantic/human evaluation.
